import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.optim as optim
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader, TensorDataset
from typing import List, Dict, Optional, Callable
import copy

# ============================================================================
# 1. Layer Freezing Pattern
# ============================================================================

class LayerFreezingPattern:
    """
    Freeze specific layers to prevent their weights from being updated during training.
    Useful for transfer learning and preventing catastrophic forgetting.
    """
    
    def __init__(self, model: nn.Module):
        """
        Initialize the layer freezing pattern.
        
        Args:
            model: PyTorch model to apply freezing to
        """
        self.model = model
        self.frozen_layers = []
    
    def freeze_by_name(self, layer_names: List[str]):
        """
        Freeze layers by their parameter names.
        
        Args:
            layer_names: List of parameter name patterns to freeze
        """
        for name, param in self.model.named_parameters():
            if any(layer_name in name for layer_name in layer_names):
                param.requires_grad = False
                self.frozen_layers.append(name)
                print(f"Frozen layer: {name}")
    
    def freeze_by_type(self, layer_types: List[type]):
        """
        Freeze all layers of specific types.
        
        Args:
            layer_types: List of layer types to freeze (e.g., [nn.Conv2d, nn.BatchNorm2d])
        """
        for name, module in self.model.named_modules():
            if isinstance(module, tuple(layer_types)):
                for param_name, param in module.named_parameters():
                    param.requires_grad = False
                    full_name = f"{name}.{param_name}"
                    self.frozen_layers.append(full_name)
                    print(f"Frozen layer: {full_name}")
    
    def freeze_first_n_layers(self, n: int):
        """
        Freeze the first n layers of the model.
        
        Args:
            n: Number of layers to freeze from the beginning
        """
        params = list(self.model.parameters())
        for i, param in enumerate(params[:n]):
            param.requires_grad = False
            print(f"Frozen parameter {i}")
    
    def freeze_backbone(self, backbone_name: str = "backbone"):
        """
        Freeze the backbone/feature extractor part of the model.
        
        Args:
            backbone_name: Name of the backbone module
        """
        if hasattr(self.model, backbone_name):
            backbone = getattr(self.model, backbone_name)
            for param in backbone.parameters():
                param.requires_grad = False
            print(f"Frozen backbone: {backbone_name}")
        else:
            print(f"Warning: Backbone '{backbone_name}' not found")
    
    def get_trainable_params(self) -> int:
        """Get count of trainable parameters."""
        return sum(p.numel() for p in self.model.parameters() if p.requires_grad)
    
    def get_frozen_params(self) -> int:
        """Get count of frozen parameters."""
        return sum(p.numel() for p in self.model.parameters() if not p.requires_grad)


# ============================================================================
# 2. Layer Unfreezing Pattern
# ============================================================================

class LayerUnfreezingPattern:
    """
    Progressively unfreeze layers during training for better fine-tuning.
    """
    
    def __init__(self, model: nn.Module):
        """
        Initialize the layer unfreezing pattern.
        
        Args:
            model: PyTorch model to apply unfreezing to
        """
        self.model = model
        self.unfrozen_layers = []
    
    def unfreeze_by_name(self, layer_names: List[str]):
        """
        Unfreeze layers by their parameter names.
        
        Args:
            layer_names: List of parameter name patterns to unfreeze
        """
        for name, param in self.model.named_parameters():
            if any(layer_name in name for layer_name in layer_names):
                param.requires_grad = True
                self.unfrozen_layers.append(name)
                print(f"Unfrozen layer: {name}")
    
    def unfreeze_last_n_layers(self, n: int):
        """
        Unfreeze the last n layers of the model.
        
        Args:
            n: Number of layers to unfreeze from the end
        """
        params = list(self.model.parameters())
        for i, param in enumerate(params[-n:]):
            param.requires_grad = True
            print(f"Unfrozen parameter {len(params) - n + i}")
    
    def unfreeze_all(self):
        """Unfreeze all layers in the model."""
        for name, param in self.model.named_parameters():
            param.requires_grad = True
            self.unfrozen_layers.append(name)
        print("All layers unfrozen")
    
    def unfreeze_by_type(self, layer_types: List[type]):
        """
        Unfreeze all layers of specific types.
        
        Args:
            layer_types: List of layer types to unfreeze
        """
        for name, module in self.model.named_modules():
            if isinstance(module, tuple(layer_types)):
                for param in module.parameters():
                    param.requires_grad = True
                print(f"Unfrozen module: {name}")


# ============================================================================
# 3. Selective Fine-tuning Pattern
# ============================================================================

class SelectiveFineTuningPattern:
    """
    Fine-tune only specific components of the model while keeping others frozen.
    Useful for domain adaptation and task-specific training.
    """
    
    def __init__(self, model: nn.Module):
        """
        Initialize selective fine-tuning pattern.
        
        Args:
            model: PyTorch model to apply selective fine-tuning
        """
        self.model = model
        self.training_groups = {}
    
    def create_training_group(self, group_name: str, layer_patterns: List[str], 
                             lr: float = 1e-3):
        """
        Create a training group with specific layers and learning rate.
        
        Args:
            group_name: Name for this training group
            layer_patterns: List of layer name patterns to include
            lr: Learning rate for this group
        """
        params = []
        for name, param in self.model.named_parameters():
            if any(pattern in name for pattern in layer_patterns):
                param.requires_grad = True
                params.append(param)
                print(f"Added to group '{group_name}': {name}")
            else:
                param.requires_grad = False
        
        self.training_groups[group_name] = {
            'params': params,
            'lr': lr
        }
    
    def get_optimizer(self, optimizer_class=optim.Adam, **kwargs) -> optim.Optimizer:
        """
        Get optimizer configured for all training groups.
        
        Args:
            optimizer_class: Optimizer class to use
            **kwargs: Additional optimizer arguments
        """
        param_groups = [
            {'params': group['params'], 'lr': group['lr']}
            for group in self.training_groups.values()
        ]
        return optimizer_class(param_groups, **kwargs)
    
    def fine_tune_classifier_only(self, classifier_name: str = "fc", lr: float = 1e-3):
        """
        Fine-tune only the classifier head.
        
        Args:
            classifier_name: Name of the classifier module
            lr: Learning rate for the classifier
        """
        # Freeze all layers
        for param in self.model.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = False
        
        # Unfreeze classifier
        if hasattr(self.model, classifier_name):
            classifier = getattr(self.model, classifier_name)
            for param in classifier.parameters():
                param.requires_grad = True
            print(f"Fine-tuning classifier: {classifier_name}")
        
        self.training_groups['classifier'] = {
            'params': [p for p in self.model.parameters() if p.requires_grad],
            'lr': lr
        }


# ============================================================================
# 4. Discriminative Learning Rate Pattern
# ============================================================================

class DiscriminativeLearningRatePattern:
    """
    Apply different learning rates to different layers of the model.
    Earlier layers get smaller learning rates, later layers get larger ones.
    """
    
    def __init__(self, model: nn.Module, base_lr: float = 1e-3, 
                 lr_multiplier: float = 2.0):
        """
        Initialize discriminative learning rate pattern.
        
        Args:
            model: PyTorch model
            base_lr: Base learning rate for the first layer
            lr_multiplier: Multiplier for each subsequent layer group
        """
        self.model = model
        self.base_lr = base_lr
        self.lr_multiplier = lr_multiplier
        self.param_groups = []
    
    def create_layer_groups(self, num_groups: int) -> List[Dict]:
        """
        Divide model into layer groups with different learning rates.
        
        Args:
            num_groups: Number of groups to divide the model into
            
        Returns:
            List of parameter groups for optimizer
        """
        # Get all named parameters
        named_params = list(self.model.named_parameters())
        params_per_group = len(named_params) // num_groups
        
        param_groups = []
        for i in range(num_groups):
            start_idx = i * params_per_group
            end_idx = start_idx + params_per_group if i < num_groups - 1 else len(named_params)
            
            # Calculate learning rate for this group
            lr = self.base_lr * (self.lr_multiplier ** i)
            
            # Get parameters for this group
            group_params = [param for name, param in named_params[start_idx:end_idx]]
            
            param_groups.append({
                'params': group_params,
                'lr': lr
            })
            
            print(f"Group {i}: {len(group_params)} parameters, lr={lr:.2e}")
        
        self.param_groups = param_groups
        return param_groups
    
    def create_module_based_groups(self, module_groups: List[List[str]]) -> List[Dict]:
        """
        Create parameter groups based on module names.
        
        Args:
            module_groups: List of lists containing module name patterns for each group
            
        Returns:
            List of parameter groups for optimizer
        """
        param_groups = []
        
        for i, patterns in enumerate(module_groups):
            lr = self.base_lr * (self.lr_multiplier ** i)
            group_params = []
            
            for name, param in self.model.named_parameters():
                if any(pattern in name for pattern in patterns):
                    group_params.append(param)
            
            if group_params:
                param_groups.append({
                    'params': group_params,
                    'lr': lr
                })
                print(f"Group {i}: {len(group_params)} parameters, lr={lr:.2e}")
        
        self.param_groups = param_groups
        return param_groups
    
    def get_optimizer(self, optimizer_class=optim.Adam, **kwargs) -> optim.Optimizer:
        """
        Get optimizer with discriminative learning rates.
        
        Args:
            optimizer_class: Optimizer class to use
            **kwargs: Additional optimizer arguments
        """
        if not self.param_groups:
            raise ValueError("Create parameter groups first using create_layer_groups or create_module_based_groups")
        
        return optimizer_class(self.param_groups, **kwargs)


# ============================================================================
# 5. Gradual Unfreezing Pattern
# ============================================================================

class GradualUnfreezingPattern:
    """
    Gradually unfreeze layers during training, starting from the last layers.
    Implements the ULMFiT-style gradual unfreezing strategy.
    """
    
    def __init__(self, model: nn.Module, unfreeze_schedule: Optional[List[int]] = None):
        """
        Initialize gradual unfreezing pattern.
        
        Args:
            model: PyTorch model
            unfreeze_schedule: List of epochs at which to unfreeze layer groups
        """
        self.model = model
        self.unfreeze_schedule = unfreeze_schedule or []
        self.current_epoch = 0
        self.layer_groups = []
        
    def create_layer_groups(self, num_groups: int):
        """
        Divide model into layer groups for gradual unfreezing.
        
        Args:
            num_groups: Number of groups to divide the model into
        """
        named_params = list(self.model.named_parameters())
        params_per_group = len(named_params) // num_groups
        
        self.layer_groups = []
        for i in range(num_groups):
            start_idx = i * params_per_group
            end_idx = start_idx + params_per_group if i < num_groups - 1 else len(named_params)
            
            group_params = [(name, param) for name, param in named_params[start_idx:end_idx]]
            self.layer_groups.append(group_params)
            
            # Initially freeze all groups
            for name, param in group_params:
                param.requires_grad = False
        
        print(f"Created {num_groups} layer groups")
    
    def unfreeze_next_group(self):
        """Unfreeze the next layer group (from last to first)."""
        # Find the last frozen group
        for i in range(len(self.layer_groups) - 1, -1, -1):
            group = self.layer_groups[i]
            if not group[0][1].requires_grad:  # If group is frozen
                for name, param in group:
                    param.requires_grad = True
                print(f"Unfrozen group {i} ({len(group)} parameters)")
                return i
        
        print("All groups already unfrozen")
        return -1
    
    def step_epoch(self, epoch: int):
        """
        Update unfreezing based on epoch number.
        
        Args:
            epoch: Current epoch number
        """
        self.current_epoch = epoch
        
        if epoch in self.unfreeze_schedule:
            self.unfreeze_next_group()
    
    def auto_unfreeze(self, total_epochs: int, num_groups: int):
        """
        Automatically create an unfreezing schedule.
        
        Args:
            total_epochs: Total number of training epochs
            num_groups: Number of layer groups
        """
        # Unfreeze one group every few epochs
        epochs_per_group = max(1, total_epochs // num_groups)
        self.unfreeze_schedule = [i * epochs_per_group for i in range(num_groups)]
        print(f"Auto-generated unfreezing schedule: {self.unfreeze_schedule}")

# 6. Layer Dropping Pattern
# ============================================================================

class LayerDroppingPattern:
    """
    Dynamically drop/skip layers during training or inference.
    Useful for model compression and efficient inference.
    """
    
    def __init__(self, model: nn.Module):
        """
        Initialize layer dropping pattern.
        
        Args:
            model: PyTorch model
        """
        self.model = model
        self.dropped_layers = set()
        self.original_forwards
```python
        self.original_forwards = {}
        
    def drop_layer_by_name(self, layer_name: str):
        """
        Drop a specific layer by replacing it with identity.
        
        Args:
            layer_name: Name of the layer to drop
        """
        # Navigate to the layer
        parts = layer_name.split('.')
        module = self.model
        
        for part in parts[:-1]:
            module = getattr(module, part)
        
        # Store original forward if not already stored
        if layer_name not in self.original_forwards:
            target_layer = getattr(module, parts[-1])
            self.original_forwards[layer_name] = target_layer.forward
        
        # Replace with identity function
        def identity_forward(x, *args, **kwargs):
            return x
        
        target_layer = getattr(module, parts[-1])
        target_layer.forward = identity_forward
        self.dropped_layers.add(layer_name)
        print(f"Dropped layer: {layer_name}")
    
    def restore_layer(self, layer_name: str):
        """
        Restore a previously dropped layer.
        
        Args:
            layer_name: Name of the layer to restore
        """
        if layer_name not in self.original_forwards:
            print(f"Layer {layer_name} was not dropped")
            return
        
        # Navigate to the layer
        parts = layer_name.split('.')
        module = self.model
        
        for part in parts[:-1]:
            module = getattr(module, part)
        
        # Restore original forward
        target_layer = getattr(module, parts[-1])
        target_layer.forward = self.original_forwards[layer_name]
        self.dropped_layers.remove(layer_name)
        print(f"Restored layer: {layer_name}")
    
    def drop_random_layers(self, drop_prob: float = 0.1):
        """
        Randomly drop layers during training (similar to DropPath).
        
        Args:
            drop_prob: Probability of dropping each layer
        """
        for name, module in self.model.named_modules():
            if isinstance(module, (nn.Linear, nn.Conv2d)):
                if torch.rand(1).item() < drop_prob:
                    self.drop_layer_by_name(name)
    
    def restore_all_layers(self):
        """Restore all dropped layers."""
        layers_to_restore = list(self.dropped_layers)
        for layer_name in layers_to_restore:
            self.restore_layer(layer_name)
    
    def prune_layers_by_importance(self, importance_scores: Dict[str, float], 
                                   threshold: float):
        """
        Drop layers based on importance scores.
        
        Args:
            importance_scores: Dictionary mapping layer names to importance scores
            threshold: Minimum importance score to keep a layer
        """
        for layer_name, score in importance_scores.items():
            if score < threshold:
                try:
                    self.drop_layer_by_name(layer_name)
                except Exception as e:
                    print(f"Could not drop {layer_name}: {e}")

class SimpleResNetBlock(nn.Module):
    """Simple ResNet-style block for demonstration."""
    
    def __init__(self, in_channels: int, out_channels: int):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(out_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        
        self.shortcut = nn.Sequential()
        if in_channels != out_channels:
            self.shortcut = nn.Sequential(
                nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 1),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
            )
    
    def forward(self, x):
        out = self.relu(self.bn1(self.conv1(x)))
        out = self.bn2(self.conv2(out))
        out += self.shortcut(x)
        out = self.relu(out)
        return out


class DemoModel(nn.Module):
    """Demo model for showcasing model surgery patterns."""
    
    def __init__(self, num_classes: int = 10):
        super().__init__()
        
        # Backbone (feature extractor)
        self.backbone = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(3, 64, 7, stride=2, padding=3),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(64),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.MaxPool2d(3, stride=2, padding=1),
            
            SimpleResNetBlock(64, 64),
            SimpleResNetBlock(64, 128),
            SimpleResNetBlock(128, 256),
            SimpleResNetBlock(256, 512),
        )
        
        # Classifier head
        self.avgpool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d((1, 1))
        self.fc = nn.Linear(512, num_classes)
    
    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.backbone(x)
        x = self.avgpool(x)
        x = torch.flatten(x, 1)
        x = self.fc(x)
        return x

class AdaptiveLayerDropping(nn.Module):
    """
    Advanced layer dropping with stochastic depth during training.
    Implements DropPath/Stochastic Depth for better regularization.
    """
    
    def __init__(self, drop_prob: float = 0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.drop_prob = drop_prob
    
    def forward(self, x, residual_func):
        """
        Apply stochastic depth to residual connection.
        
        Args:
            x: Input tensor
            residual_func: Function that computes residual
            
        Returns:
            Output with stochastic depth applied
        """
        if not self.training or self.drop_prob == 0:
            return x + residual_func(x)
        
        # Randomly drop the residual path
        keep_prob = 1 - self.drop_prob
        random_tensor = keep_prob + torch.rand(
            (x.shape[0], 1, 1, 1),
            dtype=x.dtype,
            device=x.device
        )
        binary_tensor = torch.floor(random_tensor)
        
        # Scale by keep_prob during training for correct expected value
        output = x + residual_func(x) * binary_tensor / keep_prob
        return output


class SmartFineTuner:
    """
    Intelligent fine-tuning that combines multiple patterns.
    Automatically determines the best strategy based on dataset size and similarity.
    """
    
    def __init__(self, model: nn.Module, dataset_size: int, 
                 task_similarity: float = 0.5):
        """
        Initialize smart fine-tuner.
        
        Args:
            model: PyTorch model to fine-tune
            dataset_size: Number of training samples
            task_similarity: Similarity to pretraining task (0-1)
        """
        self.model = model
        self.dataset_size = dataset_size
        self.task_similarity = task_similarity
        
        self.freezer = LayerFreezingPattern(model)
        self.unfreezer = LayerUnfreezingPattern(model)
        self.disc_lr = None
    
    def get_strategy(self) -> str:
        """
        Determine the best fine-tuning strategy based on data and task.
        
        Returns:
            Strategy name
        """
        if self.dataset_size < 1000:
            if self.task_similarity > 0.7:
                return "freeze_backbone"
            else:
                return "train_classifier_only"
        elif self.dataset_size < 10000:
            if self.task_similarity > 0.5:
                return "gradual_unfreeze"
            else:
                return "discriminative_lr"
        else:
            return "full_finetune"
    
    def apply_strategy(self) -> optim.Optimizer:
        """
        Apply the recommended fine-tuning strategy.
        
        Returns:
            Configured optimizer
        """
        strategy = self.get_strategy()
        print(f"\nApplying strategy: {strategy}")
        print(f"Dataset size: {self.dataset_size}, Task similarity: {self.task_similarity}")
        
        if strategy == "train_classifier_only":
            # Freeze everything except classifier
            self.freezer.freeze_backbone()
            optimizer = optim.Adam(
                filter(lambda p: p.requires_grad, self.model.parameters()),
                lr=1e-3
            )
            
        elif strategy == "freeze_backbone":
            # Freeze backbone, train last few layers
            self.freezer.freeze_backbone()
            self.unfreezer.unfreeze_last_n_layers(5)
            optimizer = optim.Adam(
                filter(lambda p: p.requires_grad, self.model.parameters()),
                lr=1e-4
            )
            
        elif strategy == "gradual_unfreeze":
            # Start with frozen backbone, will unfreeze gradually
            self.freezer.freeze_backbone()
            optimizer = optim.Adam(
                filter(lambda p: p.requires_grad, self.model.parameters()),
                lr=1e-4
            )
            
        elif strategy == "discriminative_lr":
            # Use discriminative learning rates
            self.unfreezer.unfreeze_all()
            self.disc_lr = DiscriminativeLearningRatePattern(
                self.model,
                base_lr=1e-5,
                lr_multiplier=3.0
            )
            self.disc_lr.create_layer_groups(num_groups=4)
            optimizer = self.disc_lr.get_optimizer(optim.AdamW, weight_decay=0.01)
            
        else:  # full_finetune
            # Train all layers with moderate learning rate
            self.unfreezer.unfreeze_all()
            optimizer = optim.Adam(self.model.parameters(), lr=1e-4)
        
        return optimizer


class LayerImportanceAnalyzer:
    """
    Analyze layer importance for intelligent layer dropping/pruning.
    """
    
    def __init__(self, model: nn.Module):
        self.model = model
        self.importance_scores = {}
    
    def compute_gradient_based_importance(self, dataloader, criterion, device):
        """
        Compute layer importance based on gradient magnitudes.
        
        Args:
            dataloader: DataLoader with sample data
            criterion: Loss function
            device: Device to run on
        """
        self.model.eval()
        
        # Initialize importance scores
        for name, param in self.model.named_parameters():
            self.importance_scores[name] = 0.0
        
        # Accumulate gradients
        for data, target in dataloader:
            data, target = data.to(device), target.to(device)
            
            self.model.zero_grad()
            output = self.model(data)
            loss = criterion(output, target)
            loss.backward()
            
            # Accumulate gradient magnitudes
            for name, param in self.model.named_parameters():
                if param.grad is not None:
                    self.importance_scores[name] += param.grad.abs().mean().item()
        
        # Normalize scores
        max_score = max(self.importance_scores.values())
        for name in self.importance_scores:
            self.importance_scores[name] /= max_score
        
        return self.importance_scores
    
    def compute_weight_based_importance(self):
        """
        Compute layer importance based on weight magnitudes.
        """
        for name, param in self.model.named_parameters():
            self.importance_scores[name] = param.abs().mean().item()
        
        # Normalize
        max_score = max(self.importance_scores.values())
        for name in self.importance_scores:
            self.importance_scores[name] /= max_score
        
        return self.importance_scores
    
    def get_top_k_layers(self, k: int) -> List[str]:
        """
        Get top k most important layers.
        
        Args:
            k: Number of top layers to return
            
        Returns:
            List of layer names
        """
        sorted_layers = sorted(
            self.importance_scores.items(),
            key=lambda x: x[1],
            reverse=True
        )
        return [name for name, score in sorted_layers[:k]]
    
    def get_layers_below_threshold(self, threshold: float) -> List[str]:
        """
        Get layers with importance below threshold (candidates for dropping).
        
        Args:
            threshold: Importance threshold
            
        Returns:
            List of layer names
        """
        return [
            name for name, score in self.importance_scores.items()
            if score < threshold
        ]

        print(f"Trainable: {trainable:,} / {total:,} ({100*trainable/total:.1f}%)")
        print(f"Optimizer groups: {len(optimizer.param_groups)}")

def print_model_summary(model: nn.Module, name: str = "Model"):
    """Print a summary of model parameters."""
    print(f"\n{name} Summary:")
    print("-" * 80)
    
    total_params = 0
    trainable_params = 0
    
    for name, param in model.named_parameters():
        param_count = param.numel()
        total_params += param_count
        if param.requires_grad:
            trainable_params += param_count
    
    print(f"Total parameters: {total_params:,}")
    print(f"Trainable parameters: {trainable_params:,}")
    print(f"Frozen parameters: {total_params - trainable_params:,}")
    print(f"Percentage trainable: {100 * trainable_params / total_params:.2f}%")
    print("-" * 80)

def save_surgery_checkpoint(model: nn.Module, frozen_layers: List[str], 
                           filepath: str):
    """
    Save model checkpoint with surgery information.
    
    Args:
        model: PyTorch model
        frozen_layers: List of frozen layer names
        filepath: Path to save checkpoint
    """
    checkpoint = {
        'model_state_dict': model.state_dict(),
        'frozen_layers': frozen_layers,
        'trainable_params': sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters() if p.requires_grad),
        'total_params': sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters())
    }
    torch.save(checkpoint, filepath)
    print(f"Checkpoint saved to {filepath}")


def load_surgery_checkpoint(model: nn.Module, filepath: str) -> List[str]:
    """
    Load model checkpoint and restore surgery state.
    
    Args:
        model: PyTorch model
        filepath: Path to checkpoint
        
    Returns:
        List of frozen layer names
    """
    checkpoint = torch.load(filepath)
    model.load_state_dict(checkpoint['model_state_dict'])
    
    # Restore frozen state
    frozen_layers = checkpoint['frozen_layers']
    for name, param in model.named_parameters():
        if name in frozen_layers:
            param.requires_grad = False
    
    print(f"Checkpoint loaded from {filepath}")
    print(f"Restored {len(frozen_layers)} frozen layers")
    
    return frozen_layers

# Advanced Combined Pattern: Progressive Fine-tuning Pipeline
# ============================================================================

class ProgressiveFineTuningPipeline:
    """
    Complete progressive fine-tuning pipeline combining multiple patterns.
    Implements a state-of-the-art transfer learning approach.
    """
    
    def __init__(self, model: nn.Module, device: torch.device):
        """
        Initialize progressive fine-tuning pipeline.
        
        Args:
            model: PyTorch model to fine-tune
            device: Device to train on
        """
        self.model = model.to(device)
        self.device = device
        
        # Initialize all patterns
        self.freezer = LayerFreezingPattern(model)
        self.unfreezer = LayerUnfreezingPattern(model)
        self.gradual = GradualUnfreezingPattern(model)
        self.disc_lr = None
        
        self.current_stage = 0
        self.stages = []
    
    def add_stage(self, name: str, epochs: int, config: Dict):
        """
        Add a training stage to the pipeline.
        
        Args:
            name: Stage name
            epochs: Number of epochs for this stage
            config: Configuration dictionary with keys:
                   - freeze_backbone: bool
                   - unfreeze_last_n: int or None
                   - use_discriminative_lr: bool
                   - base_lr: float
                   - lr_multiplier: float
        """
        self.stages.append({
            'name': name,
            'epochs': epochs,
            'config': config
        })
        print(f"Added stage '{name}' with {epochs} epochs")
    
    def setup_stage(self, stage_idx: int) -> optim.Optimizer:
        """
        Setup model and optimizer for a specific stage.
        
        Args:
            stage_idx: Index of the stage to setup
            
        Returns:
            Configured optimizer
        """
        if stage_idx >= len(self.stages):
            raise ValueError(f"Stage {stage_idx} does not exist")
        
        stage = self.stages[stage_idx]
        config = stage['config']
        
        print(f"\n{'='*80}")
        print(f"Setting up stage: {stage['name']}")
        print(f"{'='*80}")
        
        # Reset all parameters to trainable first
        for param in self.model.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = True
        
        # Apply freezing if specified
        if config.get('freeze_backbone', False):
            self.freezer.freeze_backbone()
            print("Backbone frozen")
        
        # Apply selective unfreezing
        if config.get('unfreeze_last_n') is not None:
            n = config['unfreeze_last_n']
            # First freeze all
            for param in self.model.parameters():
                param.requires_grad = False
            # Then unfreeze last n
            self.unfreezer.unfreeze_last_n_layers(n)
            print(f"Unfrozen last {n} layers")
        
        # Setup optimizer
        if config.get('use_discriminative_lr', False):
            self.disc_lr = DiscriminativeLearningRatePattern(
                self.model,
                base_lr=config.get('base_lr', 1e-5),
                lr_multiplier=config.get('lr_multiplier', 2.0)
            )
            self.disc_lr.create_layer_groups(num_groups=config.get('num_groups', 4))
            optimizer = self.disc_lr.get_optimizer(
                optim.AdamW,
                weight_decay=config.get('weight_decay', 0.01)
            )
            print("Using discriminative learning rates")
        else:
            lr = config.get('base_lr', 1e-3)
            optimizer = optim.Adam(
                filter(lambda p: p.requires_grad, self.model.parameters()),
                lr=lr,
                weight_decay=config.get('weight_decay', 0.01)
            )
            print(f"Using uniform learning rate: {lr:.2e}")
        
        # Print parameter summary
        trainable = sum(p.numel() for p in self.model.parameters() if p.requires_grad)
        total = sum(p.numel() for p in self.model.parameters())
        print(f"Trainable parameters: {trainable:,} / {total:,} ({100*trainable/total:.1f}%)")
        
        return optimizer
    
    def train_stage(self, stage_idx: int, train_loader: DataLoader, 
                   val_loader: Optional[DataLoader] = None,
                   criterion: nn.Module = None) -> Dict:
        """
        Train a specific stage.
        
        Args:
            stage_idx: Index of the stage to train
            train_loader: Training data loader
            val_loader: Validation data loader (optional)
            criterion: Loss function
            
        Returns:
            Dictionary with training history
        """
        if criterion is None:
            criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()
        
        stage = self.stages[stage_idx]
        optimizer = self.setup_stage(stage_idx)
        
        history = {
            'train_loss': [],
            'val_loss': [],
            'val_acc': []
        }
        
        for epoch in range(stage['epochs']):
            # Training
            self.model.train()
            train_loss = 0.0
            num_batches = 0
            
            for batch_idx, (data, target) in enumerate(train_loader):
                data, target = data.to(self.device), target.to(self.device)
                
                optimizer.zero_grad()
                output = self.model(data)
                loss = criterion(output, target)
                loss.backward()
                optimizer.step()
                
                train_loss += loss.item()
                num_batches += 1
            
            avg_train_loss = train_loss / num_batches
            history['train_loss'].append(avg_train_loss)
            
            # Validation
            if val_loader is not None:
                val_loss, val_acc = self.validate(val_loader, criterion)
                history['val_loss'].append(val_loss)
                history['val_acc'].append(val_acc)
                
                print(f"Stage {stage_idx} - Epoch {epoch}: "
                      f"Train Loss: {avg_train_loss:.4f}, "
                      f"Val Loss: {val_loss:.4f}, "
                      f"Val Acc: {val_acc:.2f}%")
            else:
                print(f"Stage {stage_idx} - Epoch {epoch}: "
                      f"Train Loss: {avg_train_loss:.4f}")
        
        return history
    
    def validate(self, val_loader: DataLoader, criterion: nn.Module) -> tuple:
        """
        Validate the model.
        
        Args:
            val_loader: Validation data loader
            criterion: Loss function
            
        Returns:
            Tuple of (average loss, accuracy)
        """
        self.model.eval()
        val_loss = 0.0
        correct = 0
        total = 0
        
        with torch.no_grad():
            for data, target in val_loader:
                data, target = data.to(self.device), target.to(self.device)
                
                output = self.model(data)
                loss = criterion(output, target)
                
                val_loss += loss.item()
                _, predicted = output.max(1)
                total += target.size(0)
                correct += predicted.eq(target).sum().item()
        
        avg_loss = val_loss / len(val_loader)
        accuracy = 100.0 * correct / total
        
        return avg_loss, accuracy
    
    def run_pipeline(self, train_loader: DataLoader, 
                    val_loader: Optional[DataLoader] = None,
                    criterion: nn.Module = None) -> Dict:
        """
        Run the complete fine-tuning pipeline.
        
        Args:
            train_loader: Training data loader
            val_loader: Validation data loader (optional)
            criterion: Loss function
            
        Returns:
            Dictionary with complete training history
        """
        print(f"\n{'='*80}")
        print(f"Starting Progressive Fine-tuning Pipeline")
        print(f"Total stages: {len(self.stages)}")
        print(f"{'='*80}")
        
        complete_history = {}
        
        for stage_idx in range(len(self.stages)):
            stage_name = self.stages[stage_idx]['name']
            history = self.train_stage(stage_idx, train_loader, val_loader, criterion)
            complete_history[stage_name] = history
        
        print(f"\n{'='*80}")
        print("Pipeline complete!")
        print(f"{'='*80}")
        
        return complete_history

This comprehensive implementation provides:

## **Key Features:**

### **1. Layer Freezing Pattern**
- Freeze by name, type, or position
- Freeze backbone/feature extractors
- Track frozen vs trainable parameters

### **2. Layer Unfreezing Pattern**
- Unfreeze by name or position
- Progressive unfreezing strategies
- Restore training for specific layers

### **3. Selective Fine-tuning Pattern**
- Create training groups with different configurations
- Fine-tune only specific components
- Flexible parameter grouping

### **4. Discriminative Learning Rate Pattern**
- Different learning rates for different layers
- Layer-wise or module-wise grouping
- Automatic LR scaling
### **5. Gradual Unfreezing Pattern**
- Progressive layer unfreezing during training
- Automatic scheduling
- ULMFiT-style implementation

### **6. Layer Dropping Pattern**
- Dynamic layer removal/restoration
- Stochastic depth implementation
- Importance-based pruning

### **7. Advanced Features**
- Smart fine-tuner with automatic strategy selection
- Layer importance analysis
- Progressive fine-tuning pipeline
- Complete training loops with validation

## **Usage Examples:**

class ImageClassificationFineTuner:
    """
    Real-world example: Fine-tune a model for image classification.
    """
    
    def __init__(self, pretrained_model: nn.Module, num_classes: int, device: str = 'cuda'):
        """
        Initialize fine-tuner for image classification.
        
        Args:
            pretrained_model: Pretrained model (e.g., ResNet, VGG)
            num_classes: Number of classes in target dataset
            device: Device to use for training
        """
        self.device = torch.device(device if torch.cuda.is_available() else 'cpu')
        self.model = pretrained_model.to(self.device)
        self.num_classes = num_classes
        
        # Replace classifier head
        self._replace_classifier()
        
        # Initialize surgery patterns
        self.freezer = LayerFreezingPattern(self.model)
        self.pipeline = ProgressiveFineTuningPipeline(self.model, self.device)
        
    def _replace_classifier(self):
        """Replace the final classification layer."""
        # This is model-specific; adapt based on your architecture
        if hasattr(self.model, 'fc'):
            in_features = self.model.fc.in_features
            self.model.fc = nn.Linear(in_features, self.num_classes)
        elif hasattr(self.model, 'classifier'):
            if isinstance(self.model.classifier, nn.Sequential):
                in_features = self.model.classifier[-1].in_features
                self.model.classifier[-1] = nn.Linear(in_features, self.num_classes)
            else:
                in_features = self.model.classifier.in_features
                self.model.classifier = nn.Linear(in_features, self.num_classes)
    
    def setup_three_stage_training(self):
        """
        Setup a three-stage progressive fine-tuning approach.
        
        Stage 1: Train classifier only (warm-up)
        Stage 2: Gradually unfreeze with discriminative LR
        Stage 3: Full fine-tuning with low LR
        """
        # Stage 1: Classifier warm-up
        self.pipeline.add_stage(
            name="stage1_warmup",
            epochs=5,
            config={
                'freeze_backbone': True,
                'base_lr': 1e-3,
                'use_discriminative_lr': False,
                'weight_decay': 0.01
            }
        )
        
        # Stage 2: Partial unfreezing
        self.pipeline.add_stage(
            name="stage2_partial",
            epochs=10,
            config={
                'freeze_backbone': False,
                'unfreeze_last_n': 15,
                'use_discriminative_lr': True,
                'base_lr': 1e-4,
                'lr_multiplier': 2.0,
                'num_groups': 3,
                'weight_decay': 0.01
            }
        )
        
        # Stage 3: Full fine-tuning
        self.pipeline.add_stage(
            name="stage3_full",
            epochs=15,
            config={
                'freeze_backbone': False,
                'use_discriminative_lr': True,
                'base_lr': 1e-5,
                'lr_multiplier': 3.0,
                'num_groups': 4,
                'weight_decay': 0.01
            }
        )
        
        print("Three-stage training pipeline configured")
    
    def train(self, train_loader: DataLoader, val_loader: DataLoader):
        """
        Train the model using the configured pipeline.
        
        Args:
            train_loader: Training data loader
            val_loader: Validation data loader
        """
        criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()
        history = self.pipeline.run_pipeline(train_loader, val_loader, criterion)
        return history
    
    def evaluate(self, test_loader: DataLoader) -> Dict:
        """
        Evaluate the model on test data.
        
        Args:
            test_loader: Test data loader
            
        Returns:
            Dictionary with evaluation metrics
        """
        self.model.eval()
        correct = 0
        total = 0
        all_preds = []
        all_targets = []
        
        with torch.no_grad():
            for data, target in test_loader:
                data, target = data.to(self.device), target.to(self.device)
                outputs = self.model(data)
                _, predicted = outputs.max(1)
                
                total += target.size(0)
                correct += predicted.eq(target).sum().item()
                
                all_preds.extend(predicted.cpu().numpy())
                all_targets.extend(target.cpu().numpy())
        
        accuracy = 100.0 * correct / total
        
        return {
            'accuracy': accuracy,
            'predictions': all_preds,
            'targets': all_targets
        }


class DomainAdaptationFineTuner:
    """
    Real-world example: Domain adaptation with model surgery.
    """
    
    def __init__(self, source_model: nn.Module, device: str = 'cuda'):
        """
        Initialize domain adaptation fine-tuner.
        
        Args:
            source_model: Model trained on source domain
            device: Device to use
        """
        self.device = torch.device(device if torch.cuda.is_available() else 'cpu')
        self.model = source_model.to(self.device)
        
        self.freezer = LayerFreezingPattern(self.model)
        self.disc_lr = None
        
    def setup_domain_adaptation(self, adaptation_strategy: str = 'conservative'):
        """
        Setup domain adaptation strategy.
        
        Args:
            adaptation_strategy: 'conservative', 'moderate', or 'aggressive'
        """
        if adaptation_strategy == 'conservative':
            # Freeze most layers, adapt only top layers
            self.freezer.freeze_backbone()
            
            unfreezer = LayerUnfreezingPattern(self.model)
            unfreezer.unfreeze_last_n_layers(5)
            
            lr = 1e-4
            
        elif adaptation_strategy == 'moderate':
            # Use discriminative learning rates
            self.disc_lr = DiscriminativeLearningRatePattern(
                self.model,
                base_lr=1e-5,
                lr_multiplier=2.0
            )
            self.disc_lr.create_layer_groups(num_groups=3)
            lr = None  # Will use discriminative LR
            
        else:  # aggressive
            # Fine-tune all layers with higher learning rate
            for param in self.model.parameters():
                param.requires_grad = True
            lr = 5e-4
        
        print(f"Domain adaptation setup: {adaptation_strategy}")
        
        # Create optimizer
        if self.disc_lr:
            optimizer = self.disc_lr.get_optimizer(torch.optim.AdamW, weight_decay=0.01)
        else:
            optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(
                filter(lambda p: p.requires_grad, self.model.parameters()),
                lr=lr,
                weight_decay=0.01
            )
        
        return optimizer
    
    def adapt_with_pseudo_labels(self, target_loader: DataLoader, 
                                 confidence_threshold: float = 0.9,
                                 num_epochs: int = 10):
        """
        Adapt using pseudo-labeling on target domain.
        
        Args:
            target_loader: DataLoader for target domain (unlabeled)
            confidence_threshold: Confidence threshold for pseudo-labels
            num_epochs: Number of adaptation epochs
        """
        optimizer = self.setup_domain_adaptation('moderate')
        criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()
        
        print(f"\nStarting pseudo-label adaptation for {num_epochs} epochs")
        print(f"Confidence threshold: {confidence_threshold}")
        
        for epoch in range(num_epochs):
            self.model.train()
            total_loss = 0
            num_pseudo_labels = 0
            
            for batch_idx, (data, _) in enumerate(target_loader):
                data = data.to(self.device)
                
                # Generate pseudo-labels
                with torch.no_grad():
                    outputs = self.model(data)
                    probs = torch.softmax(outputs, dim=1)
                    max_probs, pseudo_labels = probs.max(1)
                    
                    # Filter by confidence
                    mask = max_probs >= confidence_threshold
                    
                if mask.sum() == 0:
                    continue
                
                # Train on high-confidence predictions
                optimizer.zero_grad()
                outputs = self.model(data[mask])
                loss = criterion(outputs, pseudo_labels[mask])
                loss.backward()
                optimizer.step()
                
                total_loss += loss.item()
                num_pseudo_labels += mask.sum().item()
            
            avg_loss = total_loss / len(target_loader) if len(target_loader) > 0 else 0
            print(f"Epoch {epoch}: Loss={avg_loss:.4f}, "
                  f"Pseudo-labels used={num_pseudo_labels}")


class MultiTaskFineTuner:
    """
    Real-world example: Multi-task learning with selective fine-tuning.
    """
    
    def __init__(self, backbone: nn.Module, task_heads: Dict[str, nn.Module], 
                 device: str = 'cuda'):
        """
        Initialize multi-task fine-tuner.
        
        Args:
            backbone: Shared backbone network
            task_heads: Dictionary of task-specific heads
            device: Device to use
        """
        self.device = torch.device(device if torch.cuda.is_available() else 'cpu')
        self.backbone = backbone.to(self.device)
        self.task_heads = {k: v.to(self.device) for k, v in task_heads.items()}
        
        self.freezer = LayerFreezingPattern(self.backbone)
        self.task_optimizers = {}
        
    def setup_task_specific_training(self, task_name: str, freeze_backbone: bool = True):
        """
        Setup training for a specific task.
        
        Args:
            task_name: Name of the task to train
            freeze_backbone: Whether to freeze the shared backbone
        """
        if task_name not in self.task_heads:
            raise ValueError(f"Task {task_name} not found")
        
        # Freeze/unfreeze backbone
        if freeze_backbone:
            for param in self.backbone.parameters():
                param.requires_grad = False
        else:
            for param in self.backbone.parameters():
                param.requires_grad = True
        
        # Always train task head
        for param in self.task_heads[task_name].parameters():
            param.requires_grad = True
        
        # Create optimizer for this task
        params = list(self.task_heads[task_name].parameters())
        if not freeze_backbone:
            params += list(self.backbone.parameters())
        
        optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(params, lr=1e-3)
        self.task_optimizers[task_name] = optimizer
        
        print(f"Setup training for task: {task_name}")
        print(f"Backbone frozen: {freeze_backbone}")
        
        return optimizer
    
    def train_task(self, task_name: str, train_loader: DataLoader, 
                   criterion: nn.Module, num_epochs: int = 10):
        """
        Train a specific task.
        
        Args:
            task_name: Name of the task
            train_loader: Training data loader
            criterion: Loss function
            num_epochs: Number of epochs
        """
        if task_name not in self.task_optimizers:
            self.setup_task_specific_training(task_name)
        
        optimizer = self.task_optimizers[task_name]
        task_head = self.task_heads[task_name]
        
        print(f"\nTraining task: {task_name}")
        
        for epoch in range(num_epochs):
            self.backbone.train()
            task_head.train()
            
            total_loss = 0
            for data, target in train_loader:
                data, target = data.to(self.device), target.to(self.device)
                
                optimizer.zero_grad()
                
                # Forward through backbone
                features = self.backbone(data)
                
                # Forward through task head
                output = task_head(features)
                
                loss = criterion(output, target)
                loss.backward()
                
```python
                optimizer.step()
                
                total_loss += loss.item()
            
            avg_loss = total_loss / len(train_loader)
            print(f"Epoch {epoch}: Loss={avg_loss:.4f}")
    
    def train_all_tasks_alternating(self, task_loaders: Dict[str, DataLoader],
                                   task_criteria: Dict[str, nn.Module],
                                   num_epochs: int = 10):
        """
        Train all tasks in alternating fashion.
        
        Args:
            task_loaders: Dictionary of task name to DataLoader
            task_criteria: Dictionary of task name to loss function
            num_epochs: Number of epochs
        """
        # Setup all tasks
        for task_name in self.task_heads.keys():
            self.setup_task_specific_training(task_name, freeze_backbone=False)
        
        print(f"\nTraining {len(self.task_heads)} tasks alternately")
        
        for epoch in range(num_epochs):
            epoch_losses = {}
            
            for task_name in self.task_heads.keys():
                self.backbone.train()
                self.task_heads[task_name].train()
                
                optimizer = self.task_optimizers[task_name]
                criterion = task_criteria[task_name]
                loader = task_loaders[task_name]
                
                task_loss = 0
                for data, target in loader:
                    data, target = data.to(self.device), target.to(self.device)
                    
                    optimizer.zero_grad()
                    features = self.backbone(data)
                    output = self.task_heads[task_name](features)
                    
                    loss = criterion(output, target)
                    loss.backward()
                    optimizer.step()
                    
                    task_loss += loss.item()
                
                epoch_losses[task_name] = task_loss / len(loader)
            
            # Print epoch summary
            loss_str = ", ".join([f"{k}={v:.4f}" for k, v in epoch_losses.items()])
            print(f"Epoch {epoch}: {loss_str}")

class AdaptiveLearningRateScheduler:
    """
    Adaptive learning rate scheduler that works with discriminative LR.
    """
    
    def __init__(self, optimizer: torch.optim.Optimizer, mode: str = 'cosine',
                 warmup_epochs: int = 5, total_epochs: int = 100):
        """
        Initialize adaptive scheduler.
        
        Args:
            optimizer: Optimizer with parameter groups
            mode: 'cosine', 'linear', or 'step'
            warmup_epochs: Number of warmup epochs
            total_epochs: Total number of training epochs
        """
        self.optimizer = optimizer
        self.mode = mode
        self.warmup_epochs = warmup_epochs
        self.total_epochs = total_epochs
        
        # Store initial learning rates for each group
        self.base_lrs = [group['lr'] for group in optimizer.param_groups]
        self.current_epoch = 0
    
    def step(self, epoch: int):
        """
        Update learning rates for current epoch.
        
        Args:
            epoch: Current epoch number
        """
        self.current_epoch = epoch
        
        if epoch < self.warmup_epochs:
            # Warmup phase: linear increase
            factor = (epoch + 1) / self.warmup_epochs
        else:
            # Main training phase
            progress = (epoch - self.warmup_epochs) / (self.total_epochs - self.warmup_epochs)
            
            if self.mode == 'cosine':
                factor = 0.5 * (1 + torch.cos(torch.tensor(progress * 3.14159)).item())
            elif self.mode == 'linear':
                factor = 1.0 - progress
            elif self.mode == 'step':
                if progress < 0.5:
                    factor = 1.0
                elif progress < 0.75:
                    factor = 0.1
                else:
                    factor = 0.01
            else:
                factor = 1.0
        
        # Update all parameter groups
        for i, param_group in enumerate(self.optimizer.param_groups):
            param_group['lr'] = self.base_lrs[i] * factor
        
        if epoch % 10 == 0:
            lrs = [group['lr'] for group in self.optimizer.param_groups]
            print(f"Epoch {epoch} LRs: {[f'{lr:.2e}' for lr in lrs]}")


class MixedPrecisionFineTuner:
    """
    Fine-tuning with mixed precision training for efficiency.
    """
    
    def __init__(self, model: nn.Module, device: str = 'cuda'):
        """
        Initialize mixed precision fine-tuner.
        
        Args:
            model: PyTorch model
            device: Device to use
        """
        self.device = torch.device(device if torch.cuda.is_available() else 'cpu')
        self.model = model.to(self.device)
        self.scaler = torch.cuda.amp.GradScaler() if torch.cuda.is_available() else None
        
    def train_epoch(self, train_loader: DataLoader, optimizer: torch.optim.Optimizer,
                   criterion: nn.Module) -> float:
        """
        Train for one epoch with mixed precision.
        
        Args:
            train_loader: Training data loader
            optimizer: Optimizer
            criterion: Loss function
            
        Returns:
            Average loss
        """
        self.model.train()
        total_loss = 0
        
        for data, target in train_loader:
            data, target = data.to(self.device), target.to(self.device)
            
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            
            if self.scaler is not None:
                # Mixed precision training
                with torch.cuda.amp.autocast():
                    output = self.model(data)
                    loss = criterion(output, target)
                
                self.scaler.scale(loss).backward()
                self.scaler.step(optimizer)
                self.scaler.update()
            else:
                # Standard training
                output = self.model(data)
                loss = criterion(output, target)
                loss.backward()
                optimizer.step()
            
            total_loss += loss.item()
        
        return total_loss / len(train_loader)


class GradientAccumulationTrainer:
    """
    Training with gradient accumulation for larger effective batch sizes.
    """
    
    def __init__(self, model: nn.Module, accumulation_steps: int = 4,
                 device: str = 'cuda'):
        """
        Initialize gradient accumulation trainer.
        
        Args:
            model: PyTorch model
            accumulation_steps: Number of steps to accumulate gradients
            device: Device to use
        """
        self.device = torch.device(device if torch.cuda.is_available() else 'cpu')
        self.model = model.to(self.device)
        self.accumulation_steps = accumulation_steps
    
    def train_epoch(self, train_loader: DataLoader, optimizer: torch.optim.Optimizer,
                   criterion: nn.Module) -> float:
        """
        Train for one epoch with gradient accumulation.
        
        Args:
            train_loader: Training data loader
            optimizer: Optimizer
            criterion: Loss function
            
        Returns:
            Average loss
        """
        self.model.train()
        total_loss = 0
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        
        for batch_idx, (data, target) in enumerate(train_loader):
            data, target = data.to(self.device), target.to(self.device)
            
            # Forward pass
            output = self.model(data)
            loss = criterion(output, target)
            
            # Normalize loss by accumulation steps
            loss = loss / self.accumulation_steps
            loss.backward()
            
            # Update weights every accumulation_steps
            if (batch_idx + 1) % self.accumulation_steps == 0:
                optimizer.step()
                optimizer.zero_grad()
            
            total_loss += loss.item() * self.accumulation_steps
        
        # Handle remaining gradients
        if (batch_idx + 1) % self.accumulation_steps != 0:
            optimizer.step()
            optimizer.zero_grad()
        
        return total_loss / len(train_loader)

def analyze_parameter_distribution(model: nn.Module) -> Dict:
    """
    Analyze the distribution of parameters across the model.
    
    Args:
        model: PyTorch model
        
    Returns:
        Dictionary with analysis results
    """
    analysis = {
        'total_params': 0,
        'trainable_params': 0,
        'frozen_params': 0,
        'layer_stats': []
    }
    
    for name, param in model.named_parameters():
        num_params = param.numel()
        analysis['total_params'] += num_params
        
        if param.requires_grad:
            analysis['trainable_params'] += num_params
        else:
            analysis['frozen_params'] += num_params
        
        analysis['layer_stats'].append({
            'name': name,
            'shape': list(param.shape),
            'num_params': num_params,
            'trainable': param.requires_grad,
            'mean': param.data.mean().item(),
            'std': param.data.std().item()
        })
    
    return analysis


def visualize_layer_freezing(model: nn.Module):
    """
    Visualize which layers are frozen vs trainable.
    
    Args:
        model: PyTorch model
    """
    print("\n" + "="*80)
    print("Layer Freezing Visualization")
    print("="*80)
    print(f"{'Layer Name':<50} {'Trainable':<12} {'Parameters':<15}")
    print("-"*80)
    
    for name, param in model.named_parameters():
        status = "✓ Yes" if param.requires_grad else "✗ No"
        num_params = f"{param.numel():,}"
        print(f"{name:<50} {status:<12} {num_params:<15}")
    
    total = sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters())
    trainable = sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters() if p.requires_grad)
    
    print("-"*80)
    print(f"{'Total':<50} {'':<12} {total:,}")
    print(f"{'Trainable':<50} {'':<12} {trainable:,} ({100*trainable/total:.1f}%)")
    print(f"{'Frozen':<50} {'':<12} {total-trainable:,} ({100*(total-trainable)/total:.1f}%)")
    print("="*80)


def compare_training_strategies(model: nn.Module, strategies: List[Dict]):
    """
    Compare different fine-tuning strategies.
    
    Args:
        model: PyTorch model
        strategies: List of strategy configurations
    """
    print("\n" + "="*80)
    print("Training Strategy Comparison")
    print("="*80)
    
    results = []
    
    for strategy in strategies:
        # Create a copy of the model
        test_model = copy.deepcopy(model)
        
        # Apply strategy
        if strategy['type'] == 'freeze_backbone':
            freezer = LayerFreezingPattern(test_model)
            freezer.freeze_backbone()
        elif strategy['type'] == 'discriminative_lr':
            disc_lr = DiscriminativeLearningRatePattern(
                test_model,
                base_lr=strategy.get('base_lr', 1e-5),
                lr_multiplier=strategy.get('lr_multiplier', 2.0)
            )
            disc_lr.create_layer_groups(num_groups=strategy.get('num_groups', 4))
        elif strategy['type'] == 'gradual_unfreeze':
            gradual = GradualUnfreezingPattern(test_model)
            gradual.create_layer_groups(num_groups=strategy.get('num_groups', 4))
        
        # Calculate metrics
        total_params = sum(p.numel() for p in test_model.parameters())
        trainable_params = sum(p.numel() for p in test_model.parameters() if p.requires_grad)
        
        results.append({
            'name': strategy['name'],
            'total_params': total_params,
            'trainable_params': trainable_params,
            'trainable_pct': 100 * trainable_params / total_params
        })
    
    # Print comparison table
    print(f"{'Strategy':<30} {'Total Params':<15} {'Trainable':<15} {'% Trainable':<12}")
    print("-"*80)
    
    for result in results:
        print(f"{result['name']:<30} "
              f"{result['total_params']:,<15} "
              f"{result['trainable_params']:,<15} "
              f"{result['trainable_pct']:.1f}%")
    
    print("="*80)

        },
        {
            'problem': 'Not adjusting learning rate when changing trainable parameters',
            'solution': 'Recreate optimizer when changing frozen/unfrozen layers',
            'code': '''
# Wrong
unfreezer.unfreeze_last_n_layers(10)
# Continue with old optimizer

# Correct
unfreezer.unfreeze_last_n_layers(10)
optimizer = Adam(filter(lambda p: p.requires_grad, model.parameters()), lr=1e-4)
'''
        },
        {
            'problem': 'Dropping critical layers without analysis',
            'solution': 'Use importance analysis before dropping',
            'code': '''
# Wrong
dropper.drop_layer_by_name('backbone.4')  # Random dropping

# Correct
analyzer = LayerImportanceAnalyzer(model)
importance = analyzer.compute_gradient_based_importance(train_loader, criterion, device)
low_importance = analyzer.get_layers_below_threshold(0.1)
for layer in low_importance:
    dropper.drop_layer_by_name(layer)
'''
        }
    ]
    
    for i, pitfall in enumerate(pitfalls, 1):
        print(f"\n{i}. {pitfall['problem']}")
        print("-" * 80)
        print(f"Solution: {pitfall['solution']}")
        print(f"\nExample:")
        print(pitfall['code'])
    
    print("\n" + "="*80)

def benchmark_strategies():
    """Benchmark different fine-tuning strategies."""
    print("\n" + "="*80)
    print("PERFORMANCE BENCHMARK")
    print("="*80)
    
    import time
    
    model = DemoModel(num_classes=10)
    device = torch.device('cuda' if torch.cuda.is_available() else 'cpu')
    model = model.to(device)
    
    # Create dummy data
    X = torch.randn(100, 3, 224, 224)
    y = torch.randint(0, 10, (100,))
    dataset = TensorDataset(X, y)
    loader = DataLoader(dataset, batch_size=16)
    
    criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()
    
    strategies = [
        {
            'name': 'Full Training',
            'setup': lambda m: None,
            'lr': 1e-3
        },
        {
            'name': 'Frozen Backbone',
            'setup': lambda m: LayerFreezingPattern(m).freeze_backbone(),
            'lr': 1e-3
        },
        {
            'name': 'Discriminative LR',
            'setup': lambda m: DiscriminativeLearningRatePattern(m, 1e-5, 2.0).create_layer_groups(4),
            'lr': None  # Uses discriminative LR
        }
    ]
    
    results = []
    
    for strategy in strategies:
        # Reset model
        test_model = copy.deepcopy(model)
        
        # Apply strategy
        strategy['setup'](test_model)
        
        # Create optimizer
        if strategy['lr'] is not None:
            optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(
                filter(lambda p: p.requires_grad, test_model.parameters()),
                lr=strategy['lr']
            )
        else:
            disc_lr = DiscriminativeLearningRatePattern(test_model, 1e-5, 2.0)
            disc_lr.create_layer_groups(4)
            optimizer = disc_lr.get_optimizer()
        
        # Benchmark training time
        test_model.train()
        start_time = time.time()
        
        for data, target in loader:
            data, target = data.to(device), target.to(device)
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            output = test_model(data)
            loss = criterion(output, target)
            loss.backward()
            optimizer.step()
        
        elapsed_time = time.time() - start_time
        
        # Calculate metrics
        trainable_params = sum(p.numel() for p in test_model.parameters() if p.requires_grad)
        total_params = sum(p.numel() for p in test_model.parameters())
        
        results.append({
            'name': strategy['name'],
            'time': elapsed_time,
            'trainable_params': trainable_params,
            'total_params': total_params,
            'trainable_pct': 100 * trainable_params / total_params
        })
    
    # Print results
    print(f"\n{'Strategy':<25} {'Time (s)':<12} {'Trainable %':<15} {'Speedup':<10}")
    print("-" * 80)
    
    baseline_time = results[0]['time']
    for result in results:
        speedup = baseline_time / result['time']
        print(f"{result['name']:<25} "
              f"{result['time']:<12.3f} "
              f"{result['trainable_pct']:<15.1f} "
              f"{speedup:<10.2f}x")
    
    print("="*80)

def demo_adaptive_lr_scheduler():
    """Demonstrate adaptive learning rate scheduling."""
    print("\n" + "="*80)
    print("DEMO 12: Adaptive Learning Rate Scheduler")
    print("="*80)
    
    model = DemoModel(num_classes=10)
    
    # Setup discriminative learning rates
    disc_lr = DiscriminativeLearningRatePattern(model, base_lr=1e-4, lr_multiplier=2.0)
    disc_lr.create_layer_groups(num_groups=3)
    optimizer = disc_lr.get_optimizer()
    
    # Create adaptive scheduler
    scheduler = AdaptiveLearningRateScheduler(
        optimizer,
        mode='cosine',
        warmup_epochs=5,
        total_epochs=30
    )
    
    print("\nLearning rate schedule (cosine with warmup):")
    print("-" * 80)
    
    for epoch in [0, 2, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 29]:
        scheduler.step(epoch)
        lrs = [group['lr'] for group in optimizer.param_groups]
        print(f"Epoch {epoch:2d}: {' | '.join([f'{lr:.2e}' for lr in lrs])}")

def demo_multi_task_learning():
    """Demonstrate multi-task learning."""
    print("\n" + "="*80)
    print("DEMO 16: Multi-Task Learning")
    print("="*80)
    
    # Create shared backbone
    backbone = nn.Sequential(
        nn.Conv2d(3, 64, 7, stride=2, padding=3),
        nn.BatchNorm2d(64),
        nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
        nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d((1, 1)),
        nn.Flatten()
    )
    
    # Create task-specific heads
    task_heads = {
        'classification': nn.Linear(64, 10),
        'regression': nn.Linear(64, 1),
        'segmentation': nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(128, 5)
        )
    }
    
    # Create multi-task fine-tuner
    mt_finetuner = MultiTaskFineTuner(backbone, task_heads)
    
    # Setup individual tasks
    print("\n--- Setting up individual tasks ---")
    for task_name in task_heads.keys():
        mt_finetuner.setup_task_specific_training(task_name, freeze_backbone=True)
    
    # Create dummy data for each task
    print("\n--- Creating task-specific data ---")
    task_loaders = {}
    task_criteria = {}
    
    for task_name in task_heads.keys():
        X = torch.randn(50, 3, 224, 224)
        if task_name == 'regression':
            y = torch.randn(50, 1)
            criterion = nn.MSELoss()
        else:
            y = torch.randint(0, 10, (50,))
            criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()
        
        dataset = TensorDataset(X, y)
        task_loaders[task_name] = DataLoader(dataset, batch_size=16)
        task_criteria[task_name] = criterion
        
        print(f"Task '{task_name}': {len(dataset)} samples")
    
    # Train all tasks
    print("\n--- Training all tasks alternately ---")
    mt_finetuner.train_all_tasks_alternating(
        task_loaders,
        task_criteria,
        num_epochs=3
    )
    
    print("\nMulti-task training completed!")

def run_comprehensive_tests():
    """Run comprehensive tests for all patterns."""
    print("\n" + "="*80)
    print("COMPREHENSIVE TEST SUITE")
    print("="*80)
    
    test_results = {
        'passed': 0,

        ('Optimizer Creation', test_optimizer_creation),

    for test_name, test_func in tests:

    print("="*80)


def test_layer_freezing():
    """Test layer freezing functionality."""
    model = DemoModel(num_classes=10)
    freezer = LayerFreezingPattern(model)
    
    # Test freezing backbone
    initial_trainable = freezer.get_trainable_params()
    freezer.freeze_backbone()
    after_freeze = freezer.get_trainable_params()
    
    assert after_freeze < initial_trainable, "Freezing should reduce trainable params"
    
    # Test freezing by type
    freezer_2 = LayerFreezingPattern(model)
    freezer_2.freeze_by_type([nn.BatchNorm2d])
    
    # Verify BN layers are frozen
    for name, module in model.named_modules():
        if isinstance(module, nn.BatchNorm2d):
            for param in module.parameters():
                assert not param.requires_grad, f"BN layer {name} should be frozen"


def test_layer_unfreezing():
    """Test layer unfreezing functionality."""
    model = DemoModel(num_classes=10)
    
    # Freeze all layers first
    for param in model.parameters():
        param.requires_grad = False
    
    unfreezer = LayerUnfreezingPattern(model)
    
    # Test unfreezing last n layers
    unfreezer.unfreeze_last_n_layers(5)
    
    trainable_count = sum(1 for p in model.parameters() if p.requires_grad)
    assert trainable_count == 5, f"Should have 5 trainable params, got {trainable_count}"


def test_discriminative_lr():
    """Test discriminative learning rate creation."""
    model = DemoModel(num_classes=10)
    disc_lr = DiscriminativeLearningRatePattern(model, base_lr=1e-5, lr_multiplier=2.0)
    
    # Create groups
    param_groups = disc_lr.create_layer_groups(num_groups=4)
    
    assert len(param_groups) == 4, "Should create 4 parameter groups"
    
    # Verify learning rates increase
    lrs = [group['lr'] for group in param_groups]
    for i in range(len(lrs) - 1):
        assert lrs[i] < lrs[i + 1], "Learning rates should increase across groups"


def test_gradual_unfreezing():
    """Test gradual unfreezing functionality."""
    model = DemoModel(num_classes=10)
    gradual = GradualUnfreezingPattern(model)
    
    # Create groups
    gradual.create_layer_groups(num_groups=4)
    
    assert len(gradual.layer_groups) == 4, "Should create 4 layer groups"
    
    # Test unfreezing
    initial_trainable = sum(1 for p in model.parameters() if p.requires_grad)
    gradual.unfreeze_next_group()
    after_unfreeze = sum(1 for p in model.parameters() if p.requires_grad)
    
    assert after_unfreeze > initial_trainable, "Unfreezing should increase trainable params"


def test_layer_dropping():
    """Test layer dropping functionality."""
    model = DemoModel(num_classes=10)
    dropper = LayerDroppingPattern(model)
    
    # Test forward pass before dropping
    dummy_input = torch.randn(2, 3, 224, 224)
    output_before = model(dummy_input)
    
    # Drop a layer
    dropper.drop_layer_by_name('backbone.4.conv1')
    
    # Test forward pass after dropping
    output_after = model(dummy_input)
    
    assert output_before.shape == output_after.shape, "Output shape should remain same"
    
    # Restore and verify
    dropper.restore_layer('backbone.4.conv1')
    output_restored = model(dummy_input)
    
    assert output_restored.shape == output_before.shape, "Restored output shape should match"


def test_parameter_counting():
    """Test parameter counting utilities."""
    model = DemoModel(num_classes=10)
    
    total_params = sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters())
    assert total_params > 0, "Model should have parameters"
    
    # Freeze some layers
    freezer = LayerFreezingPattern(model)
    freezer.freeze_backbone()
    
    trainable = freezer.get_trainable_params()
    frozen = freezer.get_frozen_params()
    
    assert trainable + frozen == total_params, "Trainable + frozen should equal total"


def test_optimizer_creation():
    """Test optimizer creation with different patterns."""
    model = DemoModel(num_classes=10)
    
    # Test with discriminative LR
    disc_lr = DiscriminativeLearningRatePattern(model, base_lr=1e-5, lr_multiplier=2.0)
    disc_lr.create_layer_groups(num_groups=3)
    optimizer = disc_lr.get_optimizer()
    
    assert len(optimizer.param_groups) == 3, "Should have 3 parameter groups"
    
    # Test with selective fine-tuning
    selector = SelectiveFineTuningPattern(model)
    selector.create_training_group('group1', ['backbone.0'], lr=1e-3)
    optimizer = selector.get_optimizer()
    
    assert len(optimizer.param_groups) >= 1, "Should have at least 1 parameter group"
